request.config: versioned plugin-settings JSON; Gateway secret values are replaced with opaque generated reference IDs

secretReferences.gatewayInput: may refer to an external file: secret source
secretReferences.pluginValue: opaque Gateway-generated identifier; no path or URI syntax is exposed or standardized
secretReferences.matching: ActiveGrant.secret_reference must exactly match the identifier in this settings revision
secretReferences.resolution: Gateway resolves the external secret source only when an authorized scoped RedeemGrant is accepted

grantScope.lifetime: only while this ConfigApply operation is active
grantScope.crossUse: cannot be used by Call or Stream capability invocations

activation.plugin: validate candidate settings and schema, redeem required config grants, initialize candidate resources, then atomically replace in-memory active settings/resources
activation.result: applied=true and settings_revision equal to the request revision only after atomic activation succeeds
activation.failure: retain prior active revision/resources and do not report healthy/readiness for the candidate

rotation.newSettings: Gateway creates a new immutable revision and new scoped grant handles
rotation.oldHandles: revoked when the new revision activation succeeds or the plugin instance stops
rotation.oldResources: closed after atomic swap; old secret values are removed from active memory as soon as practical
rotation.restart: Gateway re-sends the current revision and newly issued grants before readiness

forbidden: plaintext secret values in ConfigApply.config or Bootstrap
external file paths in plugin settings
plugin application environment variables or local config files
logging or returning secret values, grant handles, or source paths
